title: Parental controls
intro: Keep groups, channels, movies and series behind a PIN.
unavailableText: This version of the app has no parental controls. Update it to lock content behind a PIN.
lockoutProgress: Time until you can try again
wrongPinLeft_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before a short wait.
wrongPinLeft_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before a short wait.
pinMismatch: The PINs did not match. Choose the new PIN again.
enterCurrentPin: Enter the PIN you use now.
chooseFirstPin: Choose 4 to 8 digits. Anyone who knows the PIN can open locked content and change these settings.
chooseNewPin: Choose 4 to 8 digits for the new PIN.
enterNewPinAgain: Enter the new PIN again to confirm it.
weakPin: Easy to guess. Repeated or consecutive digits are the first ones a child tries.
newPinKept: Your new PIN is kept. Enter the current PIN to finish.
pinSetToastText: Lock groups here, or lock a channel, movie or series from its menu. A forgotten PIN can't be reset, so keep it somewhere safe.
unlockText: This is locked by parental controls.
unlockManyText_one: {{count}} locked item is waiting to open.
unlockManyText_other: {{count}} locked items are waiting to open.
unlockFor: Locked content stays open for {{duration}}, or until you lock it again.
unlockUntilRestart: Locked content stays open until the app restarts, or until you lock it again.
unlockSettingsText: Unlocking opens all locked content and lets you change these settings without the PIN.
checkFailedText: Locked content cannot open until the check works. Try again in a moment.
statusOffText: Set a PIN to hide or lock groups, channels, movies and series. Only someone with the PIN can open them.
statusLockedHide: Locked content is hidden from every list and search until someone enters the PIN.
statusLockedAsk: Locked content stays visible and asks for the PIN before it opens.
unlockedUntilRestart: Locked content is open until the app restarts.
lockoutActive: Too many wrong PINs. The PIN can be tried again in {{time}}.
behaviourPinNote: Changes here ask for the PIN.
modeHideText: Locked groups and titles disappear from lists, search, favorites and Continue watching.
modeAskText: Locked groups and titles stay in lists. Opening or playing one asks for the PIN.
autoAdultText: Groups named XXX, Adult, 18+ and similar are locked without picking them one by one.
unlockLengthText: How long locked content stays open after the PIN is entered. Lock now ends it early.
confirmChangeText: Changing parental settings needs the PIN.
lockedContentText: Choose the groups to lock in each source. Single channels, movies and series lock from their menu.
locksKeptText: These locks are kept and apply again once you set a PIN.
noSourcesText: Add a source first. Locks belong to its groups, channels, movies and series.
sourceNoLocks: Nothing in this source is locked.
adultOffHint: Named like adult content. Automatic adult locks are off.
autoAdultCount_one: {{count, number}} adult group is also locked automatically.
autoAdultCount_other: {{count, number}} adult groups are also locked automatically.
autoAdultNone: None of this source's groups look like adult content.
removeLockTitle: Enter the PIN to remove the lock
lockGroupsText: Ticked groups are locked, with everything in them.
noGroupsText: Refresh the source if you expected groups of this type.
adultHiddenCount_one: {{count, number}} more adult group is locked automatically and left out of this list.
adultHiddenCount_other: {{count, number}} more adult groups are locked automatically and left out of this list.
removeLocksTitle: Enter the PIN to remove locks
removeLocksText_one: {{count, number}} group will open without the PIN.
removeLocksText_other: {{count, number}} groups will open without the PIN.
lockedHidden: It is hidden until someone enters the PIN.
lockedAsk: It asks for the PIN before it opens.
lockedWhileUnlocked: It stays open until parental controls lock again.
turnOffText: Removes the PIN. Your locks are kept for when you set a PIN again.
turnOffConfirmText: Enter the PIN. Locked content opens for everyone until a new PIN is set.
turnedOffToastText: Your locks are kept. Set a PIN to use them again.
discardText: The groups you ticked or unticked here won't be saved.
pinNoRecovery: A forgotten PIN can't be reset. Keep it somewhere safe.
